summary: The ToF window is IN this mesh and it is measurable. out/head/front_view.json recorded 'the mesh has no ToF window geom' and marked the window CANNOT DETERMINE on the mesh side; that is true of the geom list and false of the geometry. MEASURED (tools/head_frontfit.py) as the hole in this part's segmentation mask that does not contain the eye ring — the compute board renders through it — in a level front view at 8.6309 px/mm: aperture 10.658 x 6.053 mm (+-0.126 mm, one mask pixel), centre 22.387 +- 0.402 mm to the head's right of the eye-ring axis and 2.219 mm below it. The MJCF's 'tof' site (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/robot_walk.xml:254, y 22.4086 mm, minus the noenoeil ring axis at y -0.0914) sits at 22.5000 mm, 0.113 mm outboard of the aperture centre. Against the product photograph, as fractions of the head width: window 0.10842 vs 0.11392 (-0.505 mm), height 0.05998 vs 0.06462 (-0.426 mm), offset 0.24919 vs 0.24396 (+0.479 mm), all inside the 1.5 mm rule; the vertical offset reads 0.00155 vs 0.02355 (-2.018 mm) — the photograph puts the window level with the eye and the mesh 2.22 mm below it, CANNOT DETERMINE (the photograph's blob is a dark-threshold read of the aperture, not its edge)
